15 recommended clinics where you can receive Potenza in Tokyo! Compare by low price, reservation method, presence of anesthesia

In this article, we will introduce 15 recommended clinics in Tokyo where you can receive Potenza.

Comparison points
  • Low cost of Potenza treatment
  • Access within Tokyo and ease of making reservations
  • Presence of anesthesia for pain management

We have compiled a list of clinics in Tokyo where you can receive Potenza at a low price, as well as clinics that have excellent anesthesia and pain management, so if you are interested in Potenza treatment, please use this as a reference.

At Rize Clinic Shinjuku Sanchome, the anesthesia fee is included in Potenza's treatment fee.

Recommended points
  • For Potenza's treatment feeanesthesiaincludes the cost
  • Lift up Potenza 400 shots 30,000 yen
  • By combining 3 types of dedicated chips and drugs, various problems can be treated with one device.

Rize Clinic Shinjuku Sanchomein is unique in that anesthesia fees are included in the price for acne scar and pore treatment, excluding lift-up potenza.

Potenza is said to shorten downtime and cause less pain, but for those who are concerned about pain, the good thing is that anesthesia can be used.

In addition, at Rize Clinic, we can treat various problems with one device by combining three types of specialized chips and drugs.

The treatment time is a generous 60 minutes, so it is recommended for those who want to treat sagging skin, acne scars, melasma, pores, fine wrinkles, etc. without the stress of pain.

It's a 1-minute walk from the B5 exit of Shinjuku Sanchome Subway Station, making it easy to access from the station, making it easy to visit while on the go.

If you are interested in Potenza treatment at Rize Clinic Shinjuku Sanchome, please check out the official website.

My Beauty Clinic uses Elisysense, which eliminates downtime on the same day at the earliest.

Recommended points
  • Adopts Elisis sense, which ends downtime in the same day at the earliest.

  • Prophylaxis against metal allergy is provided to minimize allergic reactions after treatment

My Beauty Clinic is a clinic that uses Elisis Sense, which means that downtime can be completed on the same day at the earliest.

Difference between Potenza and Elisiscens
Elisis Sense is a treatment method that allows you to approach two different depths of the skin, the epidermis on the surface of the skin and the dermis deep inside the skin, with a single shot (pricking a needle into the skin).
There is no need to repeatedly insert and remove needles into the skin as in the case of Potenza.Minimize downtime and paincan be suppressed to
Downtime ends as soon as the same dayTherefore, it is recommended for those who want to clean their skin quickly.

In addition, Elisissens can treat areas where skin tends to overlap, such as around the eyes and neck, so it is also recommended for improving sagging eyes.

Preventative measures against metal allergies are taken to minimize allergic reactions after treatment, so even those with sensitive skin can have the treatment with confidence.

If you want to clear your skin quickly, be sure to check out the official website.
